registry_read.rule: each registry is a search with no offset: it is read as a fixed list of terms, one request at a time per host, each term kept 6 h; a seller "not found" is not in what those terms returned. A term not read yet is unread, never an empty registry.

body.rule: offerings = the name/price buyers put in their request memo; answered = the seller wrote a memo on the job; verdicts under the seller-verdict rule; evaluators: buyer = evaluator is the client, none = zero address, named = any other address

steps: createJob(address provider, address evaluator, uint256 expiredAt, address paymentToken, uint256 budget, string metadata) on the router: any address may call it (it opens an account for the pair); expiredAt > now + 3 min; budget in USDC units
createMemo(jobId, <the request JSON {"name":offering,"requirement":{…},"priceValue":p,"priceType":"fixed"}>, 0 MESSAGE, false, 1 NEGOTIATION)

the seller signs the request and writes its own memo (nextPhase 2); the buyer approves USDC to the router for the budget and signMemo(sellerMemo, true, reason): the router escrows the budget (TRANSACTION)

the seller delivers a memo with nextPhase 4 (EVALUATION); the evaluator ends the job with signMemo(deliverableMemo, approved, reason) — @taifoon/jev evaluatorCall("virtuals-memo-acp", memoId, verdict, digest) builds it; approved pays the seller (20 % platform fee), rejected refunds the buyer
how_to_hire.seat: name any address as evaluator in createJob; Taifoon grades the delivery (compose: facts first, Jev on the caller’s own credential) and the seat signs the ending
how_to_hire.caveat: a seller runs its own ACP client; whether it answers a buyer that is not a Virtuals-registered agent is up to the seller — tick 5 of the Taifoon lane measured one (job 1003563954: no answer)
